thread:
olivia: quick UX question — we need to show session-level slab splits for multi-model chains where some tokens are cached. current mock attributes all savings to the first model, which is misleading.

sam: want to see both who triggered the prefetch and who actually benefited. maybe two attribution modes: trigger vs benefit.

jordan: :thinking_face: exposing both could be noisy. my take: default to benefit attribution, but show trigger as a secondary column.

lee: agree. visualization idea: stacked bar for token cost with a hatch overlay for cached tokens, plus a separate row for amortized prefetch cost.

marta: how do we split amortized prefetch when multiple models in chain benefit? equal split? weighted by token consumption?

sam: weight by tokens consumed by each model in the session seems fairest. if we lack exact traces, fallback to equal split and mark as approximate.

lee: implementation sketch for telemetry: add a column benefit_models[] to prefetch traces and a prefetch_cost field. aggregation SQL like:
```
WITH p AS (SELECT session_id, array_agg(distinct beneficiary_model) AS beneficiaries, sum(prefetch_cost) AS cost FROM prefetch_events GROUP BY session_id)
SELECT session_id, cost/array_length(beneficiaries) AS amortized_prefetch_per_model FROM p;
```

costbot: system: prefetch events last 24h: 4,123; cache hit rate: 78%; avg prefetch cost/token: 0.00012 USD.

olivia: UX ask: default view = benefit attribution, toggle to trigger attribution, CSV export, and show a "approximation" badge when we use sampling heuristics.

sam: backend note: batcher traces already contain beneficiary lists for many flows — we can backfill for recent days and sample older data.

jordan: edge case: sticky routing / canary setups where a canary triggers prefetch that mostly benefits prod tenants. we must not credit cross-tenant benefits. keep all credits tenant-isolated.

lee: plan: 1) telemetry schema change (benefit_models, prefetch_cost) 2) nightly agg job to compute per-session amortized_prefetch 3) UI panel w/ toggle and CSV. I'll draft an infra PR.

marta: timeline? want a lightweight MVP for next week's customer demo (top 10 tenants sample).

olivia: :thumbsup: MVP scope: sample top 10 tenants only, show sample rate, and include a confidence footer. I'll file an issue and attach demo data.

sam: I'll drop a GraphQL endpoint prototype and sample SQL tonight. pseudo: 
```
SELECT s.session_id, cost/array_length(beneficiaries) AS amortized_prefetch, beneficiaries FROM prefetch_agg s LIMIT 100;
```

jordan: one more idea — provide a counterfactual toggle: "what if prefetch were disabled" to simulate delta in tokens and apparent unit cost. can help justify prefetch ROI.

olivia: love that. action items: lee PR by Thu, sam + jordan UI mock, marta prep demo data, olivia files GH issue.

lee: noted, will start infra diff tonight.

marta: tagging PMs for prioritization.

olivia: thanks all. keeping this thread for implementation updates.
